shortBulletSummary: Binance suffered a $6.3B hack; the exchange pledged to cover all user losses.
Bitcoin and altcoins plunged sharply, triggering over $1.5B in liquidations post-hack.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index dropped significantly to "Fear" (30) from "Neutral" (51).
Spot Ethereum ETFs recorded $156M in net outflows, with Bitcoin ETFs also seeing reductions.
Macro outlook: The Fed held rates steady, but future hikes and rising oil prices weigh on risk assets.
